snippets.snippet: Contractor and Permit Information to Protect Willoughby Hills Homeowners Contractors performing work in the City of Willoughby Hills must be registered annually, and before applying for a permit. All contractors are required to have a $20,000.00 bond ing obligation and certificate of liability insurance in the amount of $100,000/$300,000 for bodily injury and $50,000 for property damage (Willoughby Hills named as additionally insured). Seek a referral from someone you know who is happy with his or her contractor’s work. Solicit bids from at least three (3) contractors. The Building Department is unable to recommend contractors, but can supply a list of registered contractors. Contact the Better Business Bureau for any complaints, etc. against the contractors.
